info.title: Digital Waste Tracking API — stored data
info.description: What `beta-3` stores in MongoDB: one schema per collection (`beta-3-g<N>-<entity>s`), with example documents as relaxed Extended JSON. It has no endpoints: it only gathers the DB schemas in one document to browse. Types are MongoDB's `bsonType`, which OpenAPI tools show as an unknown keyword rather than a type. See README.md beside this file.
